question.text:
Consider the following code segment:

\[
\begin{array}{l}
\verb|z = a - b;|\\
\verb|x = 3 * z;|\\
\verb|y = z + 10;|\\
\verb|z = x + y;|\\
\verb|a = y / 2;|\\
\verb|x = a * z;|
\end{array}
\]
The minimum number of total variables required to convert the above code segment to static single assignment form is $\_\_\_\_$ .
question.subject: Compiler Design

question.text:
Consider the control flow graph given below:

\begin{array}{lll}
\text { Basic Block } & \text { Statements } & \text { Control Flow Edges } \\
\textbf { B1 } & i=1 & \mathrm{~B} 1 \rightarrow \mathrm{~B} 2 \\
\textbf { B2 } & i=i+1 ; j=1 & \mathrm{~B} 2 \rightarrow \mathrm{~B} 3 \\
\textbf { B3 } & k=i * 2 & \mathrm{~B} 3 \rightarrow \mathrm{~B} 4 \\
\textbf { B4 } & j=j+k & \mathrm{~B} 4 \rightarrow \mathrm{~B} 2 \text { (Loop) }
\end{array}

The variables which are live at the EXIT of basic block $\mathbf{2}$ are:

  1. $\text{i, j, k}$
     
  2. $\text{i, j}$
     
  3. $\text{i, k}$
     
  4. $\text{j, k}$
question.subject: Compiler Design

question.text:
Consider the following intermediate code segment:
\[
\begin{array}{l}
\verb|(1) a = 1| \\
\verb|(2) if a > 0 goto (4)| \\
\verb|(3) a = a * 2| \\
\verb|(4) b = 5| \\
\verb|(5) if b < 10 goto (10)| \\
\verb|(6) a = a + b| \\
\verb|(7) b = b + 1| \\
\verb|(8) b = b * 3| \\
\verb|(9) goto (5)| \\
\verb|(10) return a|
\end{array}
\]
The number of nodes and edges in the control-flow graph constructed for the above code, respectively, are:

  1. $6$ and $7$
     
  2. $8$ and $10$
     
  3. $5$ and $6$
     
  4. $6$ and $8$
question.subject: Compiler Design

question.text:
Consider the control flow graph below :

\[
\begin{array}{|l|l|l|}
\hline
\text{Basic Block} & \text{Statements} & \text{Control Flow Edges} \\
\hline
\textbf{B1} & a=b+c ;\ d=a * 2 & \text{B1} \to \text{B2} \\
\hline
\textbf{B2} & e=d-1 ;\ f=e / 2 & \text{B2} \to \text{B3},\text{B2} \to \text{B4}\ \text{(Conditional Split)} \\
\hline
\textbf{B3} & d=f+5 & \text{B3} \to \text{B4} \\
\hline
\textbf{B4} & g=a+d & \text{B4} \to \text{Exit} \\
\hline
\end{array}
\]

The variables which are live both at the statement in basic block $\textbf{3}$ (entry) and at the statement in basic block $\textbf{4}$ (entry) of the above control flow graph are:

  1.  $\mathrm{a, d, f}$
     
  2. $\mathrm{a, d}$
     
  3. $\mathrm{a, f}$
     
  4. $\mathrm{a}$

question.text:
Consider the following intermediate code segment:
\[
\begin{array}{l}
\verb|(1) x = 0| \\
\verb|(2) y = 10| \\
\verb|(3) if x < y goto (5)| \\
\verb|(4) x = x + 1| \\
\verb|(5) z = x * 2| \\
\verb|(6) y = y - 1| \\
\verb|(7) if y > 0 goto (3)| \\
\verb|(8) return z|
\end{array}
\]
The number of nodes and edges in the control-flow graph constructed for the above code, respectively, are:

  1. $4$ and $7$
     
  2. $5$ and $6$
     
  3. $6$ and $7$
     
  4. $7$ and $8$
